label: The word piece ' super' / ' Super' as its own token, mid-sentence: the adverb ('super sketchy', 'super talented', 'super strong', 'super clean-cut'), names ('Super Bowl', 'Super Nintendo', capitalised 'Superheroes') and 'super' split off a longer word ('superstitious'); also ' skateboard' as the start of the plural 'skateboarders' ('watch skateboarders'), and '/H' starting 'Horror' in slash genre lists ('Fantasy/Horror/Sci-Fi'). Quiet on words the tokenizer keeps whole (supermarket, supervisor, superb, supernatural, lowercase 'superheroes'), on 'very', 'really', 'mega', 'ultra', 'hyper', on a singular 'skateboard' ('rode his skateboard'), and weak on 'super friendly'.
